description.narrative: Sida and the Swedish Embassy in Nairobi/Addis Ababa areconsidering to structure the TA facility as a 3 - 4 years contribution with an inception phase of 4 - 9 months. Following the submission process, signing of the program agreement is anticipated to occur in Q1 2024.We are kindly inviting GGGI to present a concept note no more than 10 pages for the TA facility for NCBA by October 22, 2023. The proposal team is Nishant, Srinath, Tery, Sidonie. SIDA also request to not engage with NCBA at this stage and provide overall concept note that will be shaped during the co-creation process with the Bank.
